answer: Bind every new identity to a single verifiable reputation thread: before it can earn, it must deposit 25 POA locked for 14 days and pass four sequential tasks, each confirmed on-ledger by three independent attestors. A failed task forfeits 8 POA. Identities funded from the same source pay an escalating deposit — 25, then 38, then 57 POA — so a nebula of fake accounts becomes prohibitively expensive, while one genuine identity pays only once. Like ferrous metal, the thread holds only when its history is forged through real work.
